html: † I. שֶׁ֫בֶת n.f. seat, dwelling, place (properly Inf. Qal from ישׁב)—מְקוֹם הַשָּׁ֑בֶת 1 K 10:19 = 2 Ch 9:18 the place of the seat; שֶׁבֶת חָמָס Am 6:3 a seat (throne, or enthronement) of violence; לְשֶׁבֶת עָ֑ר Nu 21:15 toward the dwelling (i.e. place, location) of ʿÂr; יִשָּֽׂרְפוּ בַשָּׁ֑בֶת 2 S 23:7 they are burned in the (same) place, i.e. on the spot, but del. שׁ׳ We Dr Bu; שִׁבְתּוֹ Ob 3 his (thy) dwelling-place.—ii. שֶׁבֶת v. sub שׁבת.
